capabilities: Create Things 3 projects from Obsidian note tasks and headings
Sync task status changes from Things back into Obsidian notes
Map nested subtasks to Things checklist items and headings to Things headings
Manage sync markers that link tasks and headings to Things IDs
Match notes to Things areas via tags, file paths, or backlinks
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README warns sync markers must not be deleted or modified, recommends backing up data, and states macOS is untested (only tested on iOS).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep tasks in notes synchronized with the Things 3 task manager.

relations.evidence: 2-way task synchronization between Obsidian and Things 3 on both iOS and macOS
The plugin uses an Apple Shortcut during the process.

requires.name: Things 3 with two Apple Shortcuts installed

summary: Two-way task sync between Obsidian and Things 3 on iOS and macOS, mapping note tasks and headings to Things to-dos and projects.
